				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_offer_iran_PER hidden_effect = { every_country = { limit = { exists = yes OR = { original_tag = PER } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_FRA_OFR.58 days = 1 } } } # COLDWAR offer event
				PER = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_FRA.100 days = 1 } }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_deal_iran
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.01 } }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				PER = {
					add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_deal_iran_PER
					add_tech_bonus = {
						name = COLDWAR_FRA_wld_iran
						bonus = 0.5
						uses = 2
						category = CAT_nuclear_reactors
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.015 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = COLDWAR_FRA_wld_wld_cap
		icon = GFX_COLDWAR_VIE_nat_trade

		x = 7
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = COLDWAR_FRA_wld_nato_return

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INFLUENCE }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_FRA_wld_wld_cap"
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_wld_france_in_the_world
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_FRA_outlook_western_p3_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_start = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_end = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_change = 0.03 }
				GEN_1970_change_outlook_popularity = yes
			}
			add_stability = 0.03
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ALG }
				set_temp_variable = { percent_change = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { tag_index = FRA }
				set_temp_variable = { influence_target = ALG }
				change_influence_percentage = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = MOR }
				set_temp_variable = { percent_change = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { tag_index = FRA }
				set_temp_variable = { influence_target = MOR }
				change_influence_percentage = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = TUN }
				set_temp_variable = { percent_change = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { tag_index = FRA }
				set_temp_variable = { influence_target = TUN }
				change_influence_percentage = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.01 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
